title: Replace a kitchen faucet yourself
variant: Warm and airy, one card per step with a bold action line
prompt: How do I replace a kitchen faucet myself?
note: Warm and airy on a brown-50 ground with serif headings and a serif goal row, because the reader is a homeowner on their back under a sink who will read each card once and then look for its bold action line. Tools and materials lead as an icon list in two columns with a red stop-and-call-a-plumber box between them and the steps, each step card carries time and difficulty chips above its action line, and the two pitfalls sit inside the steps where the stuck nut and the misplaced tape happen.
